pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōushí xíngli , xiān zhuāngjìnqù de quèshì yìzhī bùnéng dàizǒu de wǎn . pà wò bǎ wǎn cóng dài dǐ mōchūlái , fàngdào zhuōshàng , shuō chuángdǐ de dōngxī bùnéng quán wǎng wài bān . zhè shì shítáng de , dǐxià hái kè zhe jìhào .
pairs.english: Packing his luggage, Tavi first put in a bowl he couldn't take. Pavo fished it from the bag's bottom and set it on the table: not everything under the bed could leave. This belonged to the dining hall, its mark still carved underneath.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维收拾行李，先装进去的却是一只不能带走的碗。
帕沃把碗从袋底摸出来，放到桌上，说床底的东西不能全往外搬。这是食堂的，底下还刻着记号。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cái xiǎngqǐ , shàng huí duān le zhōu huílái , zìjǐ yìzhí méi hái . tā bào zhe wǎn qù xǐ , huílái shí , dàikǒu yǐjīng bèi pà wò sāijìn yìzhī bù láng .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi remember he'd never returned it after bringing porridge back. He took it to wash, returning to find Pavo had stuffed a cloth wolf into his bag's mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维才想起，上回端了粥回来，自己一直没还。他抱着碗去洗，回来时，袋口已经被帕沃塞进一只布狼。

pairs.target: " tā rènshi shuǐlù ma ? " " tā rènshi xié . nǐ kànhǎo zìjǐ de jiù xíng . " lí chuán kāi háiyǒu wǔtiān . tǎ wéi méi jí zhe zhā dài , xiàwǔ xiān bǎ jièlái de yǎnsuàn shū sònghuán shūjià , yòu qù kàn xiàcì shàngkè yào yòng de cèliáng zhǐ .
pairs.english: “Does it know river routes?” “It knows shoes. Just watch yours.” Five days remained before sailing. Tavi didn't rush to tie the bag; that afternoon he returned the borrowed calculation book to its shelf, then checked the measurement sheets for his next class.
pairs.hanzi:
“它认识水路吗？”
“它认识鞋。你看好自己的就行。”
离船开还有五天。塔维没急着扎袋，下午先把借来的演算书送还书架，又去看下次上课要用的测量纸。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī qiányìtiān ràng tā chóngfù nà duì tóngtiáo , dìyīlún méiyǒu cháchū biànhuà , xiūxi hòu dìèrlún cái yǒu le yìdiǎn . tā yuányǐwéi shàng huí zuòchéng , wǎnghòu jiùsuàn huì le , jiéguǒ réng dé lǎoshí jìxià nǎ yícì méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The previous day Bai had him repeat the copper pair: no change verified on the first round, a small one on the second after rest. He'd thought one success meant knowing it thereafter, but still had to honestly record which attempts produced nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师前一天让他重复那对铜条，第一轮没有查出变化，休息后第二轮才有了一点。他原以为上回做成，往后就算会了，结果仍得老实记下哪一次没有。

pairs.target: lǎoshī jiào tā lián xiū huílái xiān zuò pǔtōng cèliáng , méiyǒu liúxià néng dàizǒu liàn de qìjù . zhǐ fàngjìn chōutì , tā qīng le kǒuqì , yòu juédé kòng .
pairs.english: The teacher told him to start with ordinary measurements after the break, leaving him no apparatus to take and practice with. Putting the sheets in his drawer, he felt relieved, then empty.
pairs.hanzi:
老师叫他连休回来先做普通测量，没有留下能带走练的器具。
纸放进抽屉，他轻了口气，又觉得空。

pairs.target: tā yílù xiǎng le xǔduō yú wān de yàngzi , què xiǎngbùchū zìjǐ zhēn dào le ànshàng , dìyībù huì kànjiàn shénme . shì mài rèfàn de péng , háishì xièhuò de rén ? wènlù shí , biérén huì buhuì yì tīng jiù zhīdào tā búshì nàlǐ de rén ? tā lián zhèzhǒng bù zhīdào dōu xiǎng dé hěn qǐjìn .
pairs.english: He had imagined Elmbay in many ways, but couldn't picture his first sight on landing: a hot-food stall or people unloading? Would people know he wasn't local just from his asking directions? Even this not knowing excited him.
pairs.hanzi: 他一路想了许多榆湾的样子，却想不出自己真到了岸上，第一步会看见什么。是卖热饭的棚，还是卸货的人？问路时，别人会不会一听就知道他不是那里的人？他连这种不知道都想得很起劲。

pairs.target: zuōfang lǐ hái liàng zhe dēng . mǐlā hé sū yǐ zhàn le xiānglín liǎngzhāng táimiàn , zhōngjiān liú zhe néng guò rén de kòngxì , xiāngzǐ chāikāi hòu píng fàngzài mùjià shàng , méiyǒu bèi diūdiào . liǎng rén kànjiàn tā lái , shuí yě méi jiào tā ná chǐ .
pairs.english: The workshop lights were still on. Mira and Suyi used neighboring benches with a passage between them, the opened boxes lying on a wooden rack, not discarded. Neither asked him to fetch a ruler on arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 作坊里还亮着灯。米拉和苏苡占了相邻两张台面，中间留着能过人的空隙，箱子拆开后平放在木架上，没有被丢掉。两人看见他来，谁也没叫他拿尺。

pairs.target: sū yǐ yǐ kāishǐ huà dāndú tíqǐ de yè lán , mǐlā réng xiǎng bǎoliú yìzǔ xiāngtǐ , shìshì néngfǒu shǎo xiē qīnglǐ de máfán .
pairs.english: Suyi had begun drawing a separately liftable leaf screen; Mira still wanted to keep a set of boxes and try reducing the cleaning trouble.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡已开始画单独提起的叶栏，米拉仍想保留一组箱体，试试能否少些清理的麻烦。

pairs.target: táoshīfu yǔnxǔ liǎngtiáolù gè zuò xiǎoyàng , yuánlái gòngtóng de shìyòng jìlù kěyǐ gèzì zhùmíng lái chù shǐyòng , bùnéng zhī xiě yígè rén de míngzì .
pairs.english: Tao allowed small prototypes along both lines. Each could use the original joint trial records with attribution, not just one person's name.
pairs.hanzi: 陶师傅允许两条路各做小样，原来共同的试用记录可以各自注明来处使用，不能只写一个人的名字。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuōwán , bǔ le yíjù : " hái méi juédìng shuí de bànfǎ hǎo . " " yě kěnéng búshì yòng zài tóngyígè dìfāng . " sū yǐ shuō . tāmen méiyǒu zài zhēng xiàqù , gèzì bǎ dōngxī nuókāi , kōng chū yìtiáo chángdèng gěi tā .
pairs.english: Mira added, “We haven't decided whose method's better.” “They might not be for the same place,” Suyi said. They didn't argue further, each shifting things to clear a long bench for him.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉说完，补了一句：“还没决定谁的办法好。”
“也可能不是用在同一个地方。”苏苡说。
她们没有再争下去，各自把东西挪开，空出一条长凳给他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng dài lǐ tāochū zhǔnbèi sòng huíjiā de bǔyī zhēn hé , shuō xiǎng wèn tāmen , chuánshàng yèlǐ zhēnxiàn néng bunéng jiè dào . mǐlā jiào tā dài zhe , sū yǐ què wèn tā dǎsuàn bǔ duōshǎo jiàn , chūmén yòu búshì dài yìjiān cáifeng pù .
pairs.english: Tavi took out the mending needle case he had meant to return home, asking whether he could borrow needle and thread aboard at night. Mira said to take it; Suyi asked how many clothes he intended to mend. A trip didn't require a whole tailor's shop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从袋里掏出准备送回家的补衣针盒，说想问她们，船上夜里针线能不能借到。米拉叫他带着，苏苡却问他打算补多少件，出门又不是带一间裁缝铺。

pairs.target: tā dǎkāi hé , lǐmiàn chúle zhēn , háiyǒu sè lāsāi de sānjié bùtóng yánsè de xiàn . liǎng rén dōu búzài jiào tā fàng huíqù .
pairs.english: He opened the case. Beside the needles were three lengths of differently colored thread Sela had tucked in. Neither told him to put it back again.
pairs.hanzi: 他打开盒，里面除了针，还有瑟拉塞的三截不同颜色的线。两人都不再叫他放回去。

pairs.target: yīwén láide wǎn , shǒulǐ ná zhe yìzhāng juàn dé jí jǐn de tú . tā dé zài lián xiū dìèrtiān péi fùqīn jiàn jiù tóngliáo , zhènghǎo tóngtǎ wéi dào yú wān de rìzi zhuàng shàng .
pairs.english: Iven came late, holding a tightly rolled map. He had to accompany his father to the old colleague on the break's second day, exactly when Tavi would arrive in Elmbay.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来得晚，手里拿着一张卷得极紧的图。他得在连休第二天陪父亲见旧同僚，正好同塔维到榆湾的日子撞上。

pairs.target: tú shì tì nà rén bǎoguǎn de yuánjiàn , zǎo gāi hái , piānpiān yòu jiè qù duì guò liǎnghuí . mǐlā wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu xiǎng guò gāncuì huà yìzhāng zìjǐ de , tā shuō xiǎng guò , ránhòu bǎ xiùkǒu fān gěi tāmen kàn , lǐtou jiá de jiùshì méi huà wán de zhǐ .
pairs.english: The map was the original kept for that man, overdue for return, yet borrowed twice more for comparisons. Mira asked whether he'd considered drawing his own. He had: turning out his cuff, he showed them the unfinished sheet tucked inside.
pairs.hanzi: 图是替那人保管的原件，早该还，偏偏又借去对过两回。米拉问他有没有想过干脆画一张自己的，他说想过，然后把袖口翻给他们看，里头夹的就是没画完的纸。

pairs.target: " yuánlái nǐ yě yǒu zuò bù wán de dōngxī . " sū yǐ shuō . " hěnduō . píngcháng juàn dé hǎo , kànbùchūlái . " tāmen dōu xiào le .
pairs.english: “So you have unfinished things too,” Suyi said. “Lots. Usually they're rolled up well; you can't see.” They all laughed.
pairs.hanzi:
“原来你也有做不完的东西。”苏苡说。
“很多。平常卷得好，看不出来。”
他们都笑了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà sānzhāng gèbùxiāngtóng de tú , hūrán wèn , yǐhòu ruò jiē le bùtóng dìfāng de huó , shìbushì lián yìqǐ zuò yì wǎn dōu dé xiān xiěxìn .
pairs.english: Looking at the three different drawings, Tavi suddenly asked whether, if they took work in different places, even sitting together for an evening would require a letter first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那三张各不相同的图，忽然问，以后若接了不同地方的活，是不是连一起坐一晚都得先写信。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān wèn tā shìbushì xián jīnwǎn tài hǎo , xiàcì jiùyào shōufèi . yīwén xiào guò yǐhòu , nábǐ zài zìjǐ nà zhāng fèizhǐ biānshàng huà le yìjiān wāi fángzi , shuō zhìshǎo huílái yǒu gè dìfāng chīfàn , méikòng de rén bùnéng bī biérén quán děng zhe , zhēn yǒushì yě bùnéng zhī zài xìn lǐ xiě yíqiè dōu hǎo .
pairs.english: Mira asked if tonight was so good he would charge next time. After laughing, Iven drew a crooked house on his scrap paper: at least somewhere to eat on returning. Busy people couldn't make everyone wait, and real trouble couldn't be hidden behind “All is well” in letters.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先问他是不是嫌今晚太好，下次就要收费。伊文笑过以后，拿笔在自己那张废纸边上画了一间歪房子，说至少回来有个地方吃饭，没空的人不能逼别人全等着，真有事也不能只在信里写一切都好。

pairs.target: sū yǐ shuō zhè fángzi méi huà mén . mǐlā jiēguò bǐ , bǔ le yíshànmén , kāi zài wūdǐng shàng . tā shuō yīwén búshì xǐhuan bǎ lù zhuànláizhuànqù ma , zhèyàng zhènghǎo .
pairs.english: Suyi said the house lacked a door. Mira took the pen and added one on the roof. Didn't Iven like twisting roads about? This was perfect.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡说这房子没画门。米拉接过笔，补了一扇门，开在屋顶上。她说伊文不是喜欢把路转来转去吗，这样正好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe bǎ zhǐ ná jìn , què méi xiào wán . tā shì zhēnde yǒudiǎn pà . guòqù juéde néng jìn bái jiē , jiù néng zài zhèlǐ zhànwěn , hòulái zhànwěn le , jìng yòu kāishǐ diànjì biéchù .
pairs.english: Laughing, Tavi drew the paper closer, but his laughter faded. He really was a little afraid. Once he'd thought entering White Steps would let him find his footing here; now he had, and was already thinking of elsewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着把纸拿近，却没笑完。他是真的有点怕。过去觉得能进白阶，就能在这里站稳，后来站稳了，竟又开始惦记别处。

pairs.target: kě mǐlā bù yídìng huì děng tā bǎ yú wān de měikuài shítou dōu kàn wán , yīwén yě búhuì yǒngyuǎn yǒukōng zuòzài sùshè tì tā cházì .
pairs.english: But Mira might not wait while he inspected every Elmbay stone, nor would Iven always have time to sit in the dormitory looking up characters for him.
pairs.hanzi: 可米拉不一定会等他把榆湾的每块石头都看完，伊文也不会永远有空坐在宿舍替他查字。

pairs.target: tā jiāng nà zhāng wāi fángzi de zhǐ tuīhuíqù , méiyǒu jiào shuí tì zìjǐ názhǔyì , zhī shuō huílái de nà dùnfàn tā lái qǐng , bié tiāo zuì guì de .
pairs.english: He pushed the crooked-house drawing back, asking nobody to make up his mind for him, only offering to buy dinner on his return, as long as they didn't choose the most expensive.
pairs.hanzi: 他将那张歪房子的纸推回去，没有叫谁替自己拿主意，只说回来的那顿饭他来请，别挑最贵的。

pairs.target: mǐlā lìkè shuō hái qiàn de yídùn bàn kěyǐ dǐ . sū yǐ shuō bùnéng , nà shì yīfu de qián . yīwén shuō liǎngdùn fàn de zhàng bùnéng yòu sāijìn yìzhāng túlǐ , yǐjīng gòu luàn le .
pairs.english: Mira immediately said the owed meal and a half could offset it. Suyi said no, that was for the coat. Iven said two dinner accounts couldn't be stuffed into one map again; it was confusing enough.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉立刻说还欠的一顿半可以抵。苏苡说不能，那是衣服的钱。伊文说两顿饭的账不能又塞进一张图里，已经够乱了。

pairs.target: chuāngwài de dēng yìzhǎnzhǎn miè , zuōfang de rén lái cuī shōugōng . tāmen bǎ dèngzǐ guīhuí yuánchù , tǎ wéi tì mǐlā bào zhe chāi xià de mùbǎn , sòngdào cúnfàng jià páng , děng tā fàngwěn le zài sōngshǒu . zhè yìhuí , tā méiyǒu xiān wǎng ménwài zǒu .
pairs.english: Lights outside went out one by one; workshop staff came to hurry closing. They put the benches back. Tavi held Mira's removed planks and carried them to the storage rack, waiting for her to settle them before letting go. This time he didn't head out first.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外的灯一盏盏灭，作坊的人来催收工。他们把凳子归回原处，塔维替米拉抱着拆下的木板，送到存放架旁，等她放稳了再松手。这一回，他没有先往门外走。

pairs.target: huí sùshè hòu , pà wò yǐjīng shuì le , bù láng hái héng zài dàikǒu . tǎ wéi jiāng zhēn hézhuāng jìnqù , yòu fàngjìn chāo xìn hé wǎngfǎn chuánpiào , zuìhòu cái bǎ nà jiàn bǔguò de wàiyī diéhǎo .
pairs.english: Back in the dormitory, Pavo was asleep, the cloth wolf still across the bag's mouth. Tavi packed the needle case, copied letter and return tickets, finally folding his patched coat.
pairs.hanzi: 回宿舍后，帕沃已经睡了，布狼还横在袋口。塔维将针盒装进去，又放进抄信和往返船票，最后才把那件补过的外衣叠好。

pairs.target: kōng zǐ ké liúzài shū páng , chì biān méiyǒu yāhuài . tā qīngqīng hé shàng dēngzhào , mōhēi bǎ shítáng de wǎn cóng zhuōshàng ná qǐ , fàngdào le míngzǎo yì chūmén jiù néng kànjiàn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The empty husk stayed by the books, its wings uncrushed. He gently closed the lamp shade and, feeling through the dark, moved the dining-hall bowl from the table to where he'd see it first thing tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 空籽壳留在书旁，翅边没有压坏。他轻轻合上灯罩，摸黑把食堂的碗从桌上拿起，放到了明早一出门就能看见的地方。
